summary:
The core of the Layout Editor (LE/07 sheet data, LE/10 sheet surface and title blocks, LE/15 markup) is far behind in VV. TV has 43 files (19,901 lines) and VV has 37 (13,311): 36 shared files, 7 TV-only, 1 VV-only. Only 6 shared files are code-identical. drift_all.tsv also labels ScaleManager, SheetModel__Leaders and Controls__TouchScreen 'header-only', but all three have code changes.

The schema file SheetRecords is at TV 1.39.0 against VV 1.15.0, and VV's normalisers DROP or COERCE TV-era fields. The field table in report b2 has 44 rows. Examples: margin regions and leaderless notes are dropped, viewport/leader/dimension group members are lost, 'area' and 'image' layers become 'mixed', depthFog and edge line-type scale are dropped, and 1:200/1:500/1:1250 scales become 1:50. So the schema must land before any VV feature port that writes these fields.

TV made the Layers list the paint order for everything (v2.106). Every VV sheet (all 4 in the local mirror) has its Viewports layer at the top, so TV's one-time RestackLegacyLayers must land before PaintOrder, SheetSurface, MarkupBridge and the PDF exporter switch over.

Drawing numbering needs Adam's decision. VV has a hand-typed Drawing No. and a VV-only DrawingCode leaf for its lazy loader. TV v2.71 composes a Document ID from a register sequence, a phase and the project code. Recommendation: adopt TV's model, keep the leaf and back-port it to TV.

Live or likely VV bugs found:
- A notes-margin change is not an undo step (ledger L219).
- DeleteLayer leaves vectors pointing at a deleted layer.
- The sheet's printed dimension figure ignores Dimension__AtScale while the Measurements box honours it.
- The Common client/site address seed never runs on the first editor load, because the loader's synthetic 'loaded' event bypasses the model's reload() (code-traced, not run).
- Any later drawings load is heard twice.

AutoSave lacks the v2.145/v2.146 draft guards. The other two guards (save judged before R2, backups) are VV transport work in 42 ProjectData, R2SaveProjectJson and WCP/server.py.

The QR title-block cell is generic code; only its link config (noble-architecture.com/q/) is NA-specific. Port it disabled until Adam picks a VV target.

TV's Classic title-block scan is a placeholder. VV's real Vale scan should move to 01__AppAssets__ValeVision/06__AppAssets__TitleBlocks.

Proposed: 12 work packages, 10 decisions, 51 findings.

findings.title: SheetRecords schema 24 versions behind (TV 1.39.0 vs VV 1.15.0)
findings.detail: VV's sheet record normaliser lacks every field TV added after v2.79: area/image layer types, reference layers, the paint-order seed with one-time restack and orphan re-homing, Shape Hatch/Qr/Curve/Area/Image/Holes, site plan records, viewport depthFog/rotation/ShowFrame/ClosedDoors/HideSwings/ModelSourceId, dimension AtScale/extension lines/RoundUp/LinePt/LineStyle, viewport/leader/dimension group members, margin regions and leaderless notes, Phase and DocumentId. 44-row field table in report b2.
findings.recommendation: Take TV's whole file (incl. the undocumented 29-Sep NormaliseProjectedEdges edits) and re-apply only: DrawingCode leaf imports, DrawingNumber default/short-code policy (D-S03b-01), keep exporting Na__LeRec__SheetShortCode until the Sheets unit lands, path 40->42. Land before any feature writing these fields.
findings.evidence: TV SheetRecords L426-444 (types, GROUP_KINDS, LAYER_STACK), L1403-1490; VV L213-218, L644-700; comment-free diff: 385 TV code lines absent in VV; TV per-file log 1.16.0-1.39.0.
findings.vv_adaptation: Import ShortCode/StripSheetCode from the VV DrawingCode leaf; VV DrawingNumber default per D-S03b-01; ../../42__System__DrawingViewCore path; ValeVision console prefix and header.

findings.title: VV normalisers DROP or COERCE TV-era fields on the next load
findings.detail: Through VV SheetRecords 1.15.0: the margin record is rebuilt from six keys (drops RegionsOn, Regions, LeaderlessOn, LeaderlessGroups); GROUP_KINDS drops viewport/leader/dimension members; 'area'/'image' layers become 'mixed'; Viewport__Styles loses depthFog; edge entries lose Category__LineTypeScale/FillHex; 1:200, 1:500, 1:1250 become 1:50; an unfilled picture, QR box or room gets Shape__Stroked forced true. A VV feature port writing these before the schema loses data on save.
findings.recommendation: Ordering rule for the swarm: WP-S03b-03 lands before, or with, every port that writes b2 rows 1-44 (50 regions/leaderless, 59 floor areas, 54 images, Layer flyout, 20 rotation, depth fog, 36 hatch, 37 booleans, dimension panel rows, viewport grouping). Gate with a golden-fixture round-trip test.
findings.evidence: VV SheetRecords L594-601 (margin rebuild), L218 (GROUP_KINDS), L213 (LAYER_TYPES), L415-424 (Styles), L320-325 (edges), L532-534 (visibility guard); VV ScaleManager L66-71.

findings.title: Layer-stack migration (RestackLegacyLayers) must precede the paint order
findings.detail: VV seeds the Viewports layer at the TOP of the Layers list (VV SheetRecords L665-671). All 4 sheets in the local mirror (3047__Doous, 44371__Gill, 57994__Harris x2) have a markup layer under a viewport layer. TV 1.26.0 restacks such a sheet once and stamps Sheet__LayerStack 2. If paint-order rendering lands first, every note, dimension and vector on existing VV sheets paints under the drawings. Under VV's current painter the restack is invisible, so it can land early.
findings.recommendation: Ship the restack with the SheetRecords port (WP-S03b-03). Ship PaintOrder's consumers (SheetSurface 1.7.0+, MarkupBridge 1.15.0+, PdfExporter) only afterwards, as one change (WP-S03b-07). Verify on the 4 local sheets plus an R2 sample: one restack, idempotent, no visual change before or after.
findings.evidence: TV SheetRecords L1347-1374, L1430-1438, L1482-1490; VV SheetRecords L665-671; WCP/Projects/2026/{3047__Doous,44371__Gill,57994__Harris__Scheme-02}/project.json layer orders (report b3).

findings.title: Drawing numbering: VV hand-typed Drawing No. vs TV v2.71 composed Document ID
findings.detail: VV prints a typed 'Drawing No.' (default projectCode-order, e.g. 3047-01); tab codes come from the STORED number only. TV v2.71 splits it into a register-written sequence (D01), a per-sheet phase (T01-T04, NA stages) and a Document ID {project}_{phase}_{drawing} in a 'Document ID' cell, used for the PDF name. RenumberSheets rewrites numbers on sheet create, duplicate, delete and reorder. Ledger L339 leaves this to Adam.
findings.recommendation: Decide D-S03b-01. Recommended: adopt TV's model with the Drawing Register and a Vale phase list. Until a register exists, RenumberSheets is a no-op in VV; check R2 for typed numbers first. Then SheetRecords, Sheets, History, title block Rows and PdfExporter (code: fields.DocumentId) can be identical.
findings.evidence: TV SheetRecords L1532-1608; VV SheetRecords L730-735; VV DrawingCode L58-66; TV Sheets L260, 329, 348, 362, 404; PdfExporter TV L477 vs VV L248; ledger L338-339; TV DEVLOG v2.71.0 (L9445).

findings.title: VV-only DrawingCode leaf: keep it in VV and back-port it to TV
findings.detail: 07/Na__LayoutEditor__DrawingCode__.js (158 lines, no imports) holds StoredNumber, ShortCode, StripSheetCode and Compose, so the lazy loader can label tabs before the editor loads (Loader L90, L541-548). Its regexes are byte-identical to TV SheetRecords ShortCode and StripSheetCode. TV has no loader and keeps the rules inline, which is the only thing stopping SheetRecords from being identical.
findings.recommendation: Keep the leaf and its name. Back-port it to TV so both apps' SheetRecords import it. If D-S03b-01 adopts v2.71, add pure DefaultNumber(order, prefix, digits) and ComposeDocumentId(format, project, phase, drawing), so pre-load tab labels match the loaded model.

findings.title: SheetModel facade 1.18.0 vs 1.35.1: late start, Save report, AnnounceRestore location
findings.detail: The TV facade listens only to the drawings CHANGED event and, if a load landed before Initialize, announces it on a microtask (1.35.0 / v2.145.0). It defines AnnounceRestore (VV keeps it in the Sheets unit), passes a report to Save (1.11.0, 1.29.0), adds FinishRegisterDeletion and NotifyRegister, and re-exports about 32 new names. VV listens to both LOADED and CHANGED and relies on the loader's synthetic 'loaded'.
findings.recommendation: Port together with the Sheets unit in one change (WP-S03b-04); path 40->42. In the same change, delete VV's Na__LeLoad__AnnounceProjectLoad (Loader L299-311) and its call (L339). Needs Na__DrawData__IsLoaded in VV 42 ProjectData.
findings.evidence: TV SheetModel L681 (AnnounceRestore), L718 (Save), L752-775 (Initialize, queueMicrotask L773); VV SheetModel L488-509 (two listeners L506-507); VV Loader L307-311, L339.
findings.vv_adaptation: 42__System__DrawingViewCore path; remove the loader's synthetic announcement.

findings.title: Likely VV bug: Common fields seed never runs on the first editor load
findings.detail: VV lazy-loads the editor, so the model initialises after the drawings load. The loader then dispatches a synthetic 'loaded' on the model's own event, bypassing reload(), the only caller of Na__LeModel__SeedCommonFields (SheetModel L504). Code-traced, not run: on first open the pack's client and site address are neither seeded nor migrated from the sheets. VV also hears any later load twice, clearing the dirty flag a draft restore just set (TV v2.145 finding).
findings.recommendation: Fixed by porting TV's facade Initialize and removing the loader's announcement (WP-S03b-04). Acceptance: on first open, a pack whose sheets share a client seeds CommonClient once, and 'loaded' is heard exactly once.
findings.evidence: VV SheetModel L497-507; VV Loader L299-311, L339; VV ProjectData L446-455, L208-216 (CHANGED inside the LOADED handler); grep: SeedCommonFields only called at SheetModel L504; TV DEVLOG v2.145.0 L2006-2050.

findings.title: SheetModel Sheets unit 1.1.0 vs 1.4.0

findings.title: SheetModel Layers unit 1.0.0 vs 1.4.0, incl. VV bug: deleting a layer orphans its vectors
findings.detail: VV DeleteLayer re-homes viewports, text, dimensions and leaders but not shapes. Vectors keep a dead layer id: still drawn, but unreachable from the Layers panel (fixed in TV 1.1.0; trap 8 of the TV FloorAreas plan). VV is also missing LayerIndexAboveDrawings and CreateLayer index (v2.106), reference layers (IsLayerSelectable, DropUnpickable, MoveToLayer, ItemLayerId; v2.123), and GetLayerByName, LayerIndexLike, IsItemPickable and silent writes (v2.127).

findings.title: SheetModel Shapes unit 1.0.0 vs 1.6.0, incl. VV InsertShape not writing its fallback layer
findings.detail: VV lacks the qr, area, image, curve, holes and hatch patch keys and create options; ShapeLayerType and ShapeLayerId (a room goes to Floor Areas, a picture to Images); InsertShape's afterId; and AnnounceShapes. VV InsertShape works out a fallback layer but never writes it, because the normaliser only fills a MISSING id, so the record keeps the dead id (latent; pastes are masked by Na__LeClip__LayerFor).
findings.recommendation: Port verbatim in WP-S03b-03 after Layers 1.2.0+ (LayerIndexAboveDrawings). Consumers: 30 ItemClipboard, 37 VectorTools, 59 FloorAreas, 54 SheetImages.

findings.title: SheetModel Viewports unit 1.1.0 vs 1.4.0
findings.detail: VV lacks: the create options modelSourceId, sitePlan, modelLayers and rotationDeg; the patch keys showFrame, closedDoors, hideSwings, modelSourceId, rotationDeg and the four site plan keys; InsertViewport's silent flag; group pruning on delete; IsSitePlanViewport and the site plan ResolveViewportSource. Without the patch keys, the 20 PlanDoors, ModelSource and ViewportRotation panels have nothing to write through.

findings.title: TextAndDimensions, Leaders and Groups units: dimension keys, delete-prunes, group kinds (one atomic set)
findings.detail: VV TextAndDimensions 1.1.0 lacks atScale, start/endExtensionMm, extensionsLinked, roundUp, linePt and dash on Create/Update, and group pruning on delete. Leaders lacks pruning (2 code lines; drift_all.tsv wrongly calls it header-only). The Groups unit lacks AddGroupMember (v2.130) and PruneGroups' viewport/leader/dimension cases (v2.141). Port markup Groups' KINDS alone and the first delete anywhere strips those members.

findings.detail: VV lacks TV 1.4.0 (no draft key until the project's sheets are in) and 1.5.0. In 1.5.0 every draft records its base; JudgeDraft restores only a draft grown from the drawings loaded and otherwise asks Apply / Discard / Decide Later; nothing writes the draft while asking. findings.title: v2.146 guards 2 and 3 (save judged before R2, backups kept) need VV transport work
findings.detail: Before R2 is written, TV checks the save against the local server's fingerprint of the drawings block (40 ProjectData 1.6.0, LocalProjectMirror 1.2.0, route /api/projects/<code>/drawings-fingerprint, 409 on a stale base, backup before overwrite). VV writes R2 first through whitecardopedia-editor-api, then mirrors to Flask (R2SaveProjectJson). VV 42 ProjectData 1.2.0 has no base or fingerprint, and WCP/server.py has no such route.
findings.recommendation: build_vv_transport (transport slice, WP-S03b-05). In WCP/server.py: fingerprint route, base check (409) and backup-before-overwrite. Carry the base header through R2SaveProjectJson phase 2. Add GetBase, WhenBaseKnown, CheckBase and SAVED_ISO_KEY to VV 42 ProjectData. The R2 Worker stays unjudged in both apps.

findings.title: History: missing 'margin' step (VV bug), 'areas' step and register-updated rewrite
findings.detail: VV STEP_REASONS lacks 'margin', although VV's Sheets unit announces it (Sheets L351). So a margin change is not an undo step and leaves the baseline stale: the next Ctrl+Z undoes two things (ledger L219, open). Also missing: 'areas' (floor areas, 1.7.0) and the 'register-updated' rewrite of kept steps (Title, DrawingNumber, Phase, DocumentId, Revision, Status; 1.6.0).
